'''Ádám Miklósi''' (born 25 September 1962) is a [[Hungary|Hungarian]] [[ethologist]], expert on dog cognition and behavior. He holds the position of professor and, between 2006 and 2024, head of the [http://etologia.elte.hu/en/home-2/ Ethology Department] at the [[ELTE Faculty of Sciences|Faculty of Sciences]] of the [[Eötvös Loránd University]] in [[Budapest]], [[Hungary]].<ref name="Department of Ethology">{{cite web |url=http://etologia.elte.hu/en/staff/  |title=Staff page of the Department of Ethology, Eötvös Loránd University |accessdate=2018-01-08}}</ref> In 2016 he was elected as a corresponding member, in 2022 as a full member of the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="HAS">{{cite web |url=http://mta.hu/english/introducing-the-newly-elected-members-of-the-hungarian-academy-of-sciences-106486  |title=Newly elected members of the HAS, 2016 |date=12 May 2016 |accessdate=2018-01-08 }}</ref> He is the co-founder and leader of the [https://ethology.elte.hu/Family_Dog_Project Family Dog Project], which aims to study human-dog interaction from an ethological perspective.<ref name="CV of Ádám Miklósi">{{cite web |url=https://biologia.elte.hu/en/staff/dr-adam-miklosi |title=CV of Ádám Miklósi at the Institute of Biology, Eötvös Loránd University |accessdate=2023-04-16}}</ref> In 2014 he published the 2nd edition of an academic volume entitled [https://global.oup.com/academic/product/dog-behaviour-evolution-and-cognition-9780199646661?cc=us&lang=en& Dog Behaviour, Evolution, and Cognition] by [[Oxford University Press]]<ref name="Dog">{{cite book |url=https://global.oup.com/academic/product/dog-behaviour-evolution-and-cognition-9780199646661?cc=us&lang=en&  |title=Dog Behaviour, Evolution, and Cognition |date=4 February 2015 |publisher=Oxford University Press |isbn=978-0-19-964666-1 |accessdate=2018-01-08}}</ref>
